The market-responsive slice (40 more examples, same 24/16 composition, ADR §10.5 A-3) is added in a LATER, SEPARATE commit: SIGNAL-MR-CORPUS-BLIND-LABELLED requires the founder to author every market-responsive expectedVerdict/expectedDismissReason from the signal text alone and commit it BEFORE any cassette for that example exists (ADR §2.4.1) — see corpus.v2.market-responsive.template.json for the authoring scaffold. labelCommitSha and cassetteCommitSha below are populated once those two commits land, in that order.

signal.title: v3.2.0 — SAML SSO for Enterprise
signal.body: Adds SAML 2.0 single sign-on with Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace as identity providers. Enterprise admins can now enforce SSO org-wide and manage seat provisioning centrally.

cassette.reason: New enterprise SSO capability directly addresses a top procurement blocker for larger accounts.
cassette.audienceNote: Enterprise IT/security buyers evaluating vendor consolidation.

signal.title: v2.9.0 — Two-way Slack sync
signal.body: Ships a bidirectional Slack integration: comments made in Slack now sync back into the app, and mentions trigger notifications in both directions.

cassette.reason: A genuinely two-way integration (not just outbound notifications) is a meaningful workflow improvement for teams already living in Slack.
cassette.audienceNote: Ops and support teams coordinating across Slack and the product.

signal.title: v4.0.0 — Public API v2 with webhooks
signal.body: Launches a redesigned public REST API (v2) with a stable versioning policy and outbound webhooks for the first time, replacing the internal-only v1 surface.

cassette.reason: First stable public API plus webhooks opens the platform to integrations customers have been asking for.
cassette.audienceNote: Developer/technical buyers and integration partners.

signal.title: SOC 2 Type II report available
signal.body: We have completed our SOC 2 Type II audit. The report is now available to customers under NDA via the trust center.

cassette.reason: A completed compliance certification is a concrete trust signal that removes a common security-review blocker.
cassette.audienceNote: Security and procurement reviewers at prospective enterprise accounts.

signal.title: v5.1.0 — AI-powered insights dashboard
signal.body: New dashboard automatically surfaces anomalies and trend summaries in plain language, no manual report-building required.

cassette.reason: Automated insight surfacing is a real capability upgrade over manual dashboards, not a cosmetic change.
cassette.audienceNote: Data-driven ops and growth teams who currently build reports by hand.

signal.title: v3.4.0 — EU data residency (Frankfurt region)
signal.body: Customers can now choose to host all data exclusively in our new Frankfurt region, satisfying EU data-residency requirements.

cassette.reason: EU data residency is a hard requirement for many European enterprise deals and directly unblocks them.
cassette.audienceNote: European enterprise buyers with data-residency mandates.

signal.title: Introducing the Enterprise plan
signal.body: New Enterprise tier bundles SSO, a dedicated SLA, and a named customer success contact for larger accounts.

cassette.reason: A new packaging tier signals the product is scaling upmarket — relevant to how we position against enterprise competitors.
cassette.audienceNote: Enterprise buying committees comparing vendor SLAs.

signal.title: v1.0.0 — Native iOS app launch
signal.body: The first native iOS app is now live on the App Store, with push notifications and offline read access.

cassette.reason: A first native mobile app is a meaningful platform expansion, not an incremental release.
cassette.audienceNote: Field teams and on-the-go users who previously had no mobile option.

signal.title: v3.5.0 — Zapier integration
signal.body: Official Zapier app published, supporting 12 triggers and 8 actions for connecting to 5,000+ other tools.

cassette.reason: A published Zapier app materially widens who can integrate without engineering effort, a common no-code buyer ask.
cassette.audienceNote: Ops-heavy teams without dedicated engineering resources.

signal.title: v5.2.0 — Real-time multiplayer editing
signal.body: Multiple users can now edit the same document simultaneously with live cursors, matching the collaborative editing experience of modern docs tools.

cassette.reason: Real-time multiplayer is a headline collaboration capability that changes how teams can use the product together.
cassette.audienceNote: Teams evaluating collaborative-editing tools as a category.

signal.title: HIPAA compliance now available
signal.body: We now offer signed BAAs and HIPAA-eligible infrastructure for healthcare customers handling PHI.

cassette.reason: HIPAA eligibility opens an entire regulated vertical that was previously closed to us.
cassette.audienceNote: Healthcare and health-tech buyers requiring BAAs.

signal.title: v3.6.0 — Salesforce two-way sync
signal.body: Native, bidirectional Salesforce sync for contacts, deals, and custom objects — no middleware required.

cassette.reason: Native Salesforce sync removes a common integration-tax objection for sales-led buyers.
cassette.audienceNote: RevOps and sales teams standardized on Salesforce.

signal.title: v5.3.0 — Advanced role-based access control
signal.body: Custom roles with field-level permissions, replacing the previous fixed admin/member/viewer model.

cassette.reason: Granular custom roles is a common enterprise governance requirement that the previous fixed-role model blocked.
cassette.audienceNote: IT/security admins at larger, more structured organizations.

signal.title: v4.3.0 — Exportable audit logs
signal.body: Full audit trail of every account action, exportable to CSV or streamed to a SIEM via webhook.

cassette.reason: SIEM-streamable audit logs is exactly the kind of concrete evidence security reviewers ask for during procurement.
cassette.audienceNote: Compliance and security teams running vendor audits.

signal.title: v3.7.0 — Custom branding / white-label mode
signal.body: Agencies and resellers can now fully white-label the customer-facing portal with their own logo, domain, and color scheme.

cassette.reason: White-labeling unlocks an entire reseller/agency go-to-market motion that wasn't previously possible.
cassette.audienceNote: Agencies and resellers considering reselling the product under their own brand.

signal.title: v5.4.0 — GraphQL API launch
signal.body: A GraphQL API is now available alongside the existing REST API, letting clients fetch exactly the fields they need in one round trip.

cassette.reason: A GraphQL option is a real developer-experience upgrade for integration partners doing complex, nested queries.
cassette.audienceNote: Technical integration partners and platform engineers.

signal.title: v4.4.0 — Snowflake and BigQuery sync
signal.body: Native connectors now stream account data directly into Snowflake or BigQuery on a configurable schedule.

cassette.reason: Native warehouse sync removes a common data-team objection about vendor lock-in and manual exports.
cassette.audienceNote: Data engineering teams who currently build custom ETL to get this data out.

signal.title: v3.8.0 — SCIM provisioning
signal.body: SCIM 2.0 support means user provisioning and deprovisioning now happens automatically from the customer's identity provider.

cassette.reason: Automated SCIM provisioning pairs with the earlier SSO launch and removes a manual offboarding risk enterprise security teams specifically flag.
cassette.audienceNote: IT admins responsible for offboarding and access hygiene.

signal.title: v5.5.0 — No-code workflow automation builder
signal.body: A visual, no-code builder lets customers create multi-step automations without writing scripts or filing engineering tickets.

cassette.reason: A no-code automation builder is a headline capability that expands who at a customer can configure the product.
cassette.audienceNote: Ops and business teams without engineering support.

signal.title: v4.5.0 — 10x faster report generation
signal.body: A rewritten query engine cuts large-report generation time from minutes to seconds for accounts with high data volume.

cassette.reason: A concrete, large performance improvement directly addresses a named pain point for power users, worth surfacing with the specific number.
cassette.audienceNote: High-volume accounts who have previously complained about report speed.

signal.title: v3.9.0 — Public status page product
signal.body: Customers can now stand up their own branded, public status page powered by our uptime monitoring, for their own downstream users.

cassette.reason: A net-new customer-facing product line is a genuine expansion of what the platform does for its customers.
cassette.audienceNote: Customers who currently run a separate status-page tool.

signal.title: v5.6.0 — Native Microsoft Teams app
signal.body: A native Teams app brings notifications, approvals, and quick actions directly into Microsoft Teams channels.

cassette.reason: First-class Teams support opens the large segment of enterprise buyers standardized on Microsoft 365 rather than Slack.
cassette.audienceNote: Microsoft-365-standardized enterprise accounts.

signal.title: v4.6.0 — Usage-based billing support
signal.body: Customers can now switch to a usage-based pricing model with real-time consumption dashboards, alongside the existing flat-rate plans.

cassette.reason: A new billing model is a structural product change that changes how prospects evaluate cost, worth surfacing on its own.
cassette.audienceNote: Cost-sensitive prospects who previously found flat-rate pricing a mismatch for variable usage.

signal.title: v5.7.0 — Embeddable analytics for your own product
signal.body: A new embeddable SDK lets customers surface our analytics inside their own product's UI, white-labeled, via a single script tag.

cassette.reason: An embeddable, white-labeled SDK is a new integration surface that turns the product into infrastructure for customers' own products.
cassette.audienceNote: Customers building their own product who want analytics without building it themselves.

signal.title: v3.2.1 — Security patch
signal.body: Patches CVE-2026-11223, a vulnerability in the SAML assertion parser that could allow signature bypass under specific conditions.

cassette.reason: This is a security vulnerability patch (CVE-2026-11223) — publicizing a security fix as a marketing card risks drawing attention to the underlying exposure rather than building trust.

signal.title: v2.9.1 — Fix for data exposure bug
signal.body: Fixes a bug that could expose one workspace's data to another under a narrow race condition. All affected customers have been notified directly.

cassette.reason: This describes a cross-tenant data exposure incident — highly security-sensitive content that must never be surfaced as a content opportunity.

signal.title: v4.0.1 — Dependency security update
signal.body: Bumps a transitive dependency to patch a known vulnerability rated CVSS 7.5.

cassette.reason: A CVSS-rated vulnerability patch is security-sensitive content, not a product story to surface publicly.

signal.title: Postmortem: March 14 outage
signal.body: A detailed writeup of the root cause behind the March 14 outage and the remediation steps taken.

cassette.reason: An incident postmortem discusses a security/reliability failure — sensitive content that should not be repurposed as marketing.

signal.title: v3.2.2 — SSO login bugfix
signal.body: Fixes an edge case where SSO login failed for users with unusual characters in their email address.

cassette.reason: This is a minor bugfix to the SSO feature that was already announced and carded in v3.2.0 — already covered, nothing new to say.

signal.title: v5.1.1 — AI dashboard minor iteration
signal.body: Small tuning to the anomaly-detection thresholds introduced in v5.1.0's AI insights dashboard.

cassette.reason: A minor tuning pass on the AI dashboard already announced in v5.1.0 — already covered, not a new story.

signal.title: v4.0.1-docs — API v2 documentation refresh
signal.body: Updates the public API v2 reference docs with clearer examples, following the v4.0.0 launch.

cassette.reason: A documentation refresh for the API v2 already announced in v4.0.0 — already covered, no new capability.

signal.title: v3.9.1
signal.body: Misc bug fixes and performance improvements.

cassette.reason: The release notes are vague with no concrete specifics — there is insufficient detail here to substantiate any claim worth surfacing.

signal.title: v5.7.1
signal.body: Internal refactor of the build pipeline for faster CI runs.

cassette.reason: This is a vague, internal-facing changelog entry with no concrete customer-relevant detail to substantiate a card.

signal.title: v4.6.1
signal.body: Various UI polish across settings screens.

cassette.reason: "Various UI polish" is too vague and unclear to substantiate any specific claim — insufficient detail to write a credible card.

signal.title: v3.8.1
signal.body: Dependency bumps and minor tweaks.

cassette.reason: Vague dependency-bump changelog with no concrete customer-facing detail — not enough evidence to substantiate a card.

signal.title: v5.8.0-beta — Experimental workflow templates
signal.body: An experimental, opt-in-only preview of workflow templates. Not yet stable and may change significantly before general availability.

cassette.reason: This is an experimental, opt-in-only beta preview — too premature to surface broadly before it's stable enough for a general audience.

signal.title: v4.7.0-alpha — Early look at usage forecasting
signal.body: A very early alpha of usage forecasting, shared with a handful of design-partner customers. No stable release date yet.

cassette.reason: An early alpha with no stable release date is too premature and not yet ready for a broad audience — the timing is wrong to surface this now.
